items.title: Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Oneonta, New York, December 28, 2005
items.q: Well you know it’s interesting because we were talking earlier about our mutual friend Joe Wilder.

ctx.x: Oh, tell me more. Uniforms absolutely. We had two or three uniforms. Yes. We had about three. Two tails, like blue and yellow, and then short. Oh yes. In those days everybody dressed well, Monk. Everybody. We used to joke in rehearsal — where my brother bought his suit. I said, “Frank, where did you get that?” “Oh Phil Cronfeld.” Phil Cronfeld was on Broadway. That was a real man’s shop. And then you had Laten’s. There was no shagginess in those days. No.
Well you know it’s interesting because we were talking earlier about our mutual friend Joe Wilder.
